name: 订阅额度
description: 在工作面板中可视化订阅账号的剩余额度：Anthropic (Claude Pro/Max)、OpenAI (ChatGPT Plus/Pro)、GitHub Copilot、OpenRouter 等，按 5 小时 / 每周 / 每月 / 余额窗口显示剩余百分比、重置倒计时与进度条（绿=剩余、灰=已用）。只显示本机已登录的账号。
author: czp0312
changelog: Release 0.4.2：移除账号备注——账号名改由检测到的身份决定：ChatGPT 用 profile claim 的 name（昵称）作标题、email 显示为卡片 chip；Claude 读 /api/oauth/profile 的 email；Copilot 读额度接口返回的登录名；都拿不到则只显示厂商名。登录与刷新时记录账号 email，取不到不写该字段，旧凭据形状不变。
safetyNotes: 插件 OAuth 多账号与手工令牌分别显示，CLI 自动发现仅作回退。优先级和额度推荐仅供手动切换，不控制宿主对话。不复用或读取 PI-Desktop 密钥库。OAuth 令牌由 Node fs 加密保存到本插件 getDataPath 目录（quota-oauth.enc）；本地密钥 quota-oauth.key 同目录保存，依赖系统文件权限，不等同系统钥匙串。登录期间 Node HTTP 仅监听 127.0.0.1:1455/53692，超时或结束关闭。令牌不写日志、不返回界面；联网走 net.fetch 白名单，shell.openExternal 仅打开服务商授权页。账号邮箱/用户名来自本地解析 OAuth 令牌、同源服务商接口（Claude /api/oauth/profile）与额度响应，不新增联网域名、不写日志。删除只清选中插件账号，不退出宿主/CLI，也不撤销服务商授权。

en.name: Subscription Quotas
en.description: Visualize the remaining quota of your subscription accounts in the work panel — Anthropic (Claude Pro/Max), OpenAI (ChatGPT Plus/Pro), GitHub Copilot, OpenRouter and more — as 5-hour / weekly / monthly / credit windows with remaining percentage, reset countdown and a progress bar (green = remaining, grey = used). Only accounts signed in on this machine are shown.
en.safetyNotes: Plugin OAuth accounts and manual tokens are displayed separately; optional CLI credentials are a fallback. Priorities and quota recommendations are advisory only and never switch host chat accounts. Never reads PI-Desktop's secret store. OAuth tokens are encrypted via Node fs in this plugin's getDataPath directory (quota-oauth.enc); quota-oauth.key is stored alongside it, so protection relies on OS file permissions, not an OS keychain. During browser login Node HTTP listens only on 127.0.0.1:1455/53692 and closes on completion or timeout. Tokens are never logged or returned to the panel. Requests use net.fetch's allowlist; shell.openExternal opens vendor authorization pages. Account emails/usernames come from locally parsed OAuth tokens, same-origin vendor endpoints (Claude /api/oauth/profile) and quota responses, with no new network domains and no logging. Removal deletes only the selected plugin account, not host/CLI logins or vendor grants.

settings.title: 自动发现 CLI / 编辑器账号
settings.description: 作为回退读取 Claude Code / Codex / Copilot 凭据文件。关闭后仍查询本插件授权和手工令牌账号。无需安装 CLI，可在面板的管理账号中单独登录。

settings.title: 演示数据（不访问网络）
settings.description: 只渲染内置示例账号，便于预览界面。

settings.title: 自动刷新间隔（秒）
settings.description: 面板打开时轮询新数据的间隔，最小 30 秒。

settings.title: 手工令牌（JSON 对象）
settings.description: 厂商 id → 令牌。例如 {"openrouter":"sk-or-...","anthropic":"...","openai-codex":"...","github-copilot":"...","kimi-coding":"...","meta":"...","radius":"...","xai":"..."}。填了才算已登录。

settings.title: 自定义额度来源（JSON 数组）
settings.description: 给没有内置适配器的厂商配置接口：{ vendor, label, url, token?, headers?, windows?: [{ path, period?, usedField?, resetField?, minutesField?, label? }] }。不写 windows 时按常见字段名自动识别。

settings.title: 手动额度（JSON 数组，不联网）
settings.description: 直接手填窗口：{ id, label, plan?, windows: [{ period, label?, used?, limit?, unit?, usedPercent?, resetsAt? }] }。period 取 session / day / week / month / credit。
